Subject: Dedicated capacity: GPU sizing & unit-economics follow-up (next steps)

Hi Tom,

Great to meet you and the NovaPay platform team earlier — thanks for a very constructive call. Per our discussion I wanted to capture the pricing/volume items that will dictate Dedicated sizing and the unit-economics we should target. If you can confirm (or correct) the bullets below we can run a quick capacity/price model and get back with a recommended SKU + a preliminary Reserved offer.

Quick summary of what we heard:
- Primary model family: instruction-tuned open foundation model (similar to Llama-4-equivalent) with avg response length ~150 tokens.
- Target workloads: realtime payments UX (short responses) + notifications (longer templated responses).
- Desired unit-econ ceiling: ~$150 per 1M tokens (NovaPay target; willing to consider up to $200 for H100-backed SLA during initial period).

Questions / ask-for-confirmation:
1) Monthly token volume (baseline / peak): you mentioned a pilot week equivalent to ~400M tokens/mo and a potential scale to ~1B tokens/mo within 6 months — confirm if baseline =~400M/mo and peak =~1B/mo.
2) Preferred GPU for Dedicated: you said latency-sensitive -> prefer H100 (80GB) if cost delta reasonable; otherwise A100 (80GB) is acceptable. Confirm preference.
3) Initial reserved pool size: does 2 GPUs (for pilot) -> scale to 6-8 GPUs sound right? Any minimum concurrency targets we should assume (requests/sec or simultaneous in-flight sessions)?
4) Throughput & latency targets: target p95 gen latency <300ms for short responses (<60 tokens); can we accept higher for longer-form templates?
5) Budget cadence: are you evaluating monthly committed spend or annual reserved? (this matters for discounting on Reserved pricing).

Next steps I propose:
- Please attach a 48-72h traffic sample (CSV) and a short doc with 3 representative prompts/response lengths. That lets our SE team (cc'd Rishi) run a realistic throughput test.
- Schedule a 60-min sizing session with Rishi this week to lock GPU SKUs and concurrency assumptions.
- I will prepare and share a scoped Dedicated price estimate (monthly reserved + suggested node count + expected token unit-econ) for you and procurement.

Attached: novapay_traffic_sample.csv (placeholder) & a short pricing worksheet we kick off from.

Thanks — speak soon.

Best,

Marissa — thanks for the recap and clear list. Confirmations below and some more detail from our side.

1) Volumes: baseline = ~420M tokens/month (pilot QTR) with expected growth to 1.0–1.2B tokens/month within 6 months if pilot KPIs hit. We see large daily variance: weekdays peak ~2.5x baseline hour.
2) GPU preference: H100 (80GB) is preferred because latency impacts conversion for chat flows. We'll tolerate A100 if the cost gap is >30% and SLA for tail latency is guaranteed.
3) Reserved pool: start with 3x GPUs for the pilot (redundancy + A/B testing of two model variants), plan to scale to 8 GPUs by month 4. Concurrency target for pilot: ~600 concurrent sessions (avg 15 req/min per session) with avg response 150 tokens.
4) Throughput/latency: target p95 gen latency <300ms for responses <60 tokens; for 150-token responses aim p95 <800ms. Peak sustained throughput expectation at pilot: ~1.2M tokens/hour (~333 tokens/sec) across the pool; peak bursts up to ~2.5M tokens/hour.
5) Budget: procurement is evaluating a Quarters-based commit. Target unit-econ: $120–$180 per 1M tokens (goal <$150). We can commit to a 12-month reserved contract if the pricing aligns.

I've attached a 48h traffic sample (novapay_traffic_sample.csv) and a short prompt set in the Google Doc linked. We'll need a formal pricing worksheet to take to procurement; Rishi, can you run a quick sizing model against the attached sample?

Thanks — Tom

Tom / team — thanks for the traffic sample and the clear targets. Quick notes from an SE sizing perspective before we run a formal model:

- Based on a 3x H100 pilot pool + your traffic profile (avg 150-token responses, peaks described), we expect sustained throughput in the ballpark of 250–400 tokens/sec per GPU depending on quantization and model variant. That maps roughly to ~2.7M–4.3M tokens/hour across 3 GPUs sustained; so your stated peak~2.5M/hr is within that pilot capacity, but bursts closer to 2.5M/hr will require headroom or temporary burst capacity.
- If NovaPay needs p95 <300ms for short responses, H100 is the safer default; A100 may meet average latency but will be closer to the p95 SLA boundary for high-concurrency bursts.
- For unit-econ target ($120–$150 per 1M tokens): Dedicated pricing will combine (a) reserved node monthly fee (based on GPU SKU + infra), (b) estimated ops overhead (network, storage), and (c) a modeled per-token marginal cost. With a 12-month commit we can approach the lower end of that range for H100-backed capacity.

I'd like to schedule a 60-min sizing session where we run the traffic sample through a capacity model and validate latency curves across model variants and quantization knobs. Proposed times:
- Tue 2026-05-20 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue 2026-05-20 15:00–16:00 PT

If either works reply with preferred slot and any stakeholders to include (procurement, infra). Also attaching a preliminary pricing worksheet I will populate with three scenarios: pilot (3xH100), mid-scale (6xH100), and cost-optimized (8xA100).

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_pricing_estimate.xlsx

Regards,
